**Key finding:** Marseille has no 2-star Michelin restaurants — the city jumps straight from 1-star to 3-star. The artifact covers all three 3-star options with practical reservation and pricing detail: Le Petit Nice Passedat (seafood, sea view, €230 entry), AM par Alexandre Mazzia (avant-garde, €115 entry lunch), and La Villa Madie in Cassis 30 min away (best terrace, €195 entry).
